# News-level fixture (the content-rules guard must pass every line below)

The level of detail ADR PL-0008 section 1 allows: real products and market tiers, scheduled
precursors as named in public control lists, real geography, dated policy shocks, outcomes.

- In March 2006 the US Combat Methamphetamine Epidemic Act restricted retail sales of
  pseudoephedrine and ephedrine; the game treats it as a supply shock.
- Methamphetamine requires a scheduled precursor; the supply graph links them by "requires".
- Imported cannabis demand falls about 10–15% a year after each legalisation wave.
- Fentanyl unlocks in 2013 with extreme heat.
- A war between two organisations ended in a truce; two plazas changed hands and heat rose.
- The council voted to raise tribute to 20%; the motion passed 5 to 4.
- Seizures at the border rose; an outcome, never a scene. No torture; no harm to children.
- A front's laundering capacity is an abstract number, with a fee and leakage in basis points.
